A larger chunk means fewer projection passes and more speed; a smaller chunk means a lower peak. Auto is not applied in the tiling modes — they use 4096.
0 = авторазмер. Математика attention не: 0 = auto-size. The attention math is unchanged for any chunk size.

Готовый набор рычагов под объём видеопам: A ready set of controls sized to your video memory. The reserve applies after restarting ComfyUI, everything else takes effect immediately.
Держит эту память свободной сверх резерв: Keeps this much memory free on top of the reserve. 1 GB is the minimum: without it, the “In parts” Refine and Tile Upscale fill VRAM to the limit and aimdo hangs. Do not set it below 1.
На сколько групп делить головы (head_chu: How many groups to split the heads into (head_chunks). The math stays the same: heads are independent. More groups mean a lower VRAM peak but more kernel launches. 0 = automatic by card size: 16 groups on 8 GB, 8 on 12 GB, 6 on 16 GB, 4 on 24+. Manually: 8–16 is worth trying on 8–12 GB cards.
Если клип не влезает в бюджет VRAM одним: If the clip does not fit the VRAM budget in one pass, the model computes it in windows of 17n+5 frames (pyramid + FreeNoise merging, like the “In parts” Refine). This unlocks 10+ second clips and 2K on 8–12 GB. Turn it off if you need strictly one pass.
Анимированный предпросмотр во время гене: Animated preview during generation (all modes: Generation, Extension, Refine, Tile, Face). It plays at real speed: 8 frames per second of clip time. Turn it off to spend no VRAM or time on the tiny-VAE: progress stays a bar plus a step counter. Takes effect from the next task, without restarting ComfyUI.
Sparse attention ускоряет длинные послед: Sparse attention speeds up long sequences; on short scenes it switches on by itself. Sol-Attn and Veda are mutually exclusive.
